persistence.serialization: JSON with custom SetEncoder/object_hook for set/deque support

files.rp-phrases.json: RP commands for reply messages (dict[str, str])
files.personality.md: System prompt for all AI providers
files.botinfo.md: Bot info text for 'пибот био' command

files.groq-key: Backup Groq key file (not used; key stored in .env)
files.openrouter-key: Backup OpenRouter key file (not used; key stored in .env)
files.telegram-token: Backup token file (not used; token stored in .env)

source.pibot.py: Main bot code (~1490 lines, class PiBot + AIBackend + PiBotMiddleware + RateLimiter)

root_config_files.docker-compose.yml: Docker Compose with env vars and persistent volume
root_config_files.requirements.txt: Python dependencies with pinned exact versions

middleware.scope: All incoming Message events via self.dp.message.middleware()
middleware.purpose: Inject chat_data/bot_data from persistence, track message IDs, update username_map and known_chats, maintain chat_history for AI context, anti-spam (progressive warning → restrictChatMember)

initialization.token: Read from TELEGRAM_TOKEN env var (from .env via python-dotenv)
initialization.personality: Loaded from bot-data/personality.md into self.personality (shared across all AI providers)
initialization.providers: Initialized via self._init_providers() — creates AIBackend instances for each configured provider
initialization.commands: Registered in self._register_commands() — populates self.commands dict
initialization.dispatcher: Creates aiogram Bot + Dispatcher, registers middleware, message handler, callback query handler, startup/shutdown hooks

0_middleware.description: Runs before handle_message for every Message event
steps: Initialize chat_data / bot_data for the chat
Update known_chats set and username_map in bot_data
Append to chat_history if group/supergroup (last AI_MAX_HISTORY=20 messages)
Anti-spam: progressive warning (6-9 msgs/sec) → mute (>9 msgs/sec) for non-admin users

message_processing_order.1_pre_check: PiBot._pre_check(): Block banned users (self.banned_users), filter old messages (>120s unless starts with 'пибот'). Returns False to drop silently.
message_processing_order.2_commands: PiBot._handle_command(): If text starts with 'пибот ', parse subcommand via prefix matching. Dev_only commands check dev_ids; regular commands check rank against CommandConfig.value.
message_processing_order.3_ignored_check: is_user_ignored(): Check if user is in trigger-spam timeout (ignored_until from chat_data).
message_processing_order.4_rp_commands: PiBot._handle_rp(): If reply-to message and text matches key in rp-phrases.json, format {mention1}/{mention2} and respond.
message_processing_order.5_trigger_phrases: PiBot._handle_phrase(): Exact match in phrases.json. Supports SPECIAL_RESPONSES for __botinfo__/__changelog__/__commandlist__.
message_processing_order.6_ai_response: PiBot._handle_ai(): Get current AI provider from bot_data['llm_provider'], check @mention for groups, acquire ai_limiter (2/60s), build messages with personality + history, call provider.generate(), handle RateLimitError and generic errors.

command_system.storage: CommandConfig: dataclass with fields handler (Callable), value (int), dev_only (bool)
command_system.access_check: If dev_only=True, only user in dev_ids can execute. Else user_rank <= command.value.
command_system.subcommand_parsing: Iterate words from longest to shortest, find first match in self.commands. Supports multi-word subcommands ('кинь в гулаг', 'очистка бд', 'все чаты').

2.name: Admin+
2.description: Appointed by Owner via 'пибот ранг 2 для @user'

rank_system.determination: get_user_rank(): 1) Check Telegram owner (ChatMemberStatus.CREATOR → rank 1). 2) Check stored ranks in chat_data['ranks']. 3) Check Telegram admin (ChatMemberStatus.ADMINISTRATOR → rank 3). 4) Default rank 4.
rank_system.assignment_rules: Cannot change Owner's rank. Cannot assign rank >= your own. Telegram admins cannot be set to rank 4; non-admins cannot be set to ranks 2 or 3.

сотри.description: Delete last n tracked messages from per-chat deque (thread-safe via asyncio.Lock). Continues on API errors, reports total deleted. Batches of 100.

кикни.description: Kick user (ban + unban). Checks immunity via target_immune_to_mkb().

кинь в гулаг.description: Telegram ban user with revoke_messages=True + add to in-memory self.banned_users (synced to bot_data).

верни.description: Telegram unban user (only_if_banned=True) + remove from self.banned_users

заблокируй.description: Add user ID to self.banned_users (synced to bot_data). No Telegram interaction.

разблокируй.description: Remove user ID from self.banned_users (synced to bot_data). Returns warning if not in list.

мут.description: Mute user for n minutes (float, min 0.5). No n = indefinite mute. Checks immunity.

ранг.description: Change user rank (n = 2, 3, 4). Cannot change Owner's rank, assign rank >= your own, or set admins to rank 4.

ии.description: Show inline keyboard with enabled AI providers. Current provider has ✅ prefix. Only the command caller can interact with buttons.

все чаты.description: Show list of all known chats (up to 50, with count of remaining). Shows title, type icon, and ID.

очистка бд.description: Clear all persisted data (chat_data, user_data, bot_data). Reinitialize known_chats and username_map as empty.

dev_id_system.purpose: Elevated access for dev_only commands (ии, заблокируй, разблокируй, все чаты, очистка бд)
dev_id_system.check: If subcommand has dev_only=True, check user_id in self.dev_ids (in-memory set). No rank fallback.

banned_users_system.storage: In-memory set self.banned_users, initialized from bot_data['banned_users'] in _on_startup
banned_users_system.check: Banned users blocked at _pre_check() and middleware — no commands, RP, triggers, or AI

modification.кинь в гулаг: adds target + Telegram ban with revoke_messages=True
modification.верни: removes target + Telegram unban with only_if_banned=True

architecture.property: enabled → bool (True if client is not None)
architecture.method: generate(messages) → str — calls client.chat.completions.create(), handles exceptions

ai_system.init: self._init_providers(groq_key, openrouter_key) — creates AIBackend for each configured key
ai_system.selection: bot_data['llm_provider'] stores current provider name. Default: first enabled provider.
ai_system.selection_ui: пибот ии → InlineKeyboardMarkup with buttons. Callback data: 'aichange:{user_id}:{provider_name}'. Only caller can interact.

rate_limiting.limiter: self.ai_limiter (single RateLimiter shared by all providers)
rate_limiting.exceeded_message: ⚠️ Есть такая штука. Лимит вызовов AI API называется. Пока что 2 раза в минуту

personality.fallback: If file not found: 'Ты — Пибот, 25-летняя томбой. Отвечай коротко и по делу.'

context.private_chat: self.conversation_history[user_id] — in-memory list of {role, content} dicts (lost on restart)
context.group_chat: self.chat_history[chat_id] — last AI_MAX_HISTORY=20 messages from all users, formatted as @user said: text (populated in PiBotMiddleware)

ai_system.message_construction: PiBot._build_ai_messages(): system prompt (personality) + history context + user query
ai_system.trigger: Private chat: any message. Group/supergroup: only when bot is @mentioned (via _is_bot_mentioned).

error_handling.RateLimitError: Log warning + '⚠️ Ты достиг лимита апи, задрот'
error_handling.generic Exception: Log error + '⚠️ Ошибка при обращении к ИИ'

ai_system.history_after_response: In private chat only: append user query and assistant response to conversation_history

rp_system.trigger: Reply to a message with exact text matching a key (no prefix required)
rp_system.spam_filter: track_trigger_spam(): >5 identical RP triggers in 10s → 'Ой всё' + 60s ignore
rp_system.rate_limiter: self.rate_limiter.acquire() (5/s global) — if exceeded, message silently dropped

template_vars.{mention1}: Author of the reply message (formatted by get_mention)

antispam.scope: All group/supergroup messages from non-admin, non-banned users
antispam.algorithm: Sliding window per user (1s), tracked in chat_data['spam_tracker']

limits.warning_threshold: 6-9 messages in 1s — single warning '⚠️ @user, пожалуйста, не флуди!' (1x via spam_warned)
limits.mute_threshold: >9 messages in 1s — restrictChatMember with NO_PERMISSIONS for 60s

exemptions: Messages matching trigger phrases or RP commands

trigger_spam_filter.scope: RP commands and phrase triggers (tracked in track_trigger_spam)
trigger_spam_filter.penalty: User added to chat_data['ignored_until'] for 60s, bot responds 'Ой всё'
trigger_spam_filter.check: is_user_ignored() in handle_message — drops message if in timeout

age_filter.purpose: Ignore old messages re-delivered on bot restart
age_filter.exception: Messages starting with 'пибот' prefix bypass the age filter

validation.TELEGRAM_TOKEN: Must be non-empty and not equal to placeholder 'YOUR-TELEGRAM-TOKEN'

startup_config.error_behavior: ValueError with user-friendly message in Russian, exit without starting bot

deployment.systemd: sudo cp pibot.service /etc/systemd/system/ && sudo systemctl enable --now pibot

main_entry.main: Entry point: load_dotenv, load_config (validates TELEGRAM_TOKEN, GROQ_KEY, OPENROUTER_KEY), setup_logging, create PiBot, run
main_entry.load_config: Read TELEGRAM_TOKEN, GROQ_KEY, OPENROUTER_KEY from os.getenv (loaded from .env via dotenv)

pi_bot_init.PiBot.__init__: Load phrases/rp/dev_ids, create persistence, bot, dispatcher, register middleware/handlers/hooks, load personality, init providers
pi_bot_init.PiBot._init_providers: Create AIBackend instances for groq and openrouter based on provided keys
pi_bot_init.PiBot._ensure_ai_provider: Validate bot_data['llm_provider'] points to an enabled provider; fallback to first enabled
pi_bot_init.PiBot._get_current_provider: Return AIBackend from bot_data['llm_provider'] or first enabled, or None
pi_bot_init.PiBot._register_commands: Populate self.commands dict with CommandConfig for all 17 commands
pi_bot_init.PiBot._on_startup: Load persistence, init banned_users, get bot info, start periodic cleanup, notify devs

message_processing.PiBot._pre_check: Banned user check, age filter. Returns False to drop message silently.
message_processing.PiBot._handle_command: Parse 'пибот ' prefix, lookup CommandConfig, check dev_only or rank, execute handler
message_processing.PiBot._handle_rp: Reply message + key in rp_commands → format {mention1}/{mention2} and respond with rate limit + spam filter
message_processing.PiBot._handle_phrase: Key in phrases → respond with {mention} replacement. Supports SPECIAL_RESPONSES for file-based content
message_processing.PiBot._handle_ai: Get current provider, check @mention, acquire rate limiter, build messages, call provider, handle errors, save history
message_processing.PiBot._build_ai_messages: Build message list: system prompt (personality) + conversation/chat history + user query
message_processing.PiBot._is_bot_mentioned: Check message entities for @mention or text mention of the bot
message_processing.PiBot._strip_mention: Remove bot mention from message text (for group AI queries)

middleware.PiBotMiddleware.__call__: Inject chat_data/bot_data, track message IDs, maintain chat_history, anti-spam with progressive mute

command_handlers.handle_nuke: пибот сотри n — delete n+1 tracked messages with batch processing
command_handlers.handle_kick: пибот кикни @user — ban then unban with immunity check
command_handlers.handle_ban: пибот кинь в гулаг @user — Telegram ban + bot_data sync
command_handlers.handle_unban: пибот верни @user — Telegram unban + bot_data sync
command_handlers.handle_block: пибот заблокируй <id|@user> — dev_only, add to banned_users without Telegram interaction
command_handlers.handle_unblock: пибот разблокируй <id|@user> — dev_only, remove from banned_users
command_handlers.handle_mute: пибот мут @user [n] — parse optional duration suffix, restrict with NO_PERMISSIONS
command_handlers.handle_rank: пибот ранг n для @user — validate rules, store in chat_data['ranks']
command_handlers.handle_rank_list: пибот ранги — list users with ranks 2 and 3
command_handlers.handle_ai_cmd: пибот ии — dev_only, show inline keyboard with enabled providers
command_handlers.handle_all_chats: пибот все чаты — dev_only, list known chats from bot_data
command_handlers.handle_clear_db: пибот очистка бд — dev_only, clear persistence and reinitialize

callback_handlers._handle_ai_change: Parse 'aichange:{user_id}:{provider}' callback data, verify caller, update bot_data['llm_provider'], edit message

utilities.RateLimiter: Sliding window rate limiter with asyncio.Lock (used for global rate and AI rate)
utilities.get_user_rank: Determine user's rank (1-4): Telegram owner → stored rank → Telegram admin → 4
utilities.resolve_user: Resolve @username, text mention, or reply target to User object
utilities.track_trigger_spam: Track trigger phrase frequency with sliding window, return True if limit exceeded
utilities._read_text_file_async: Generic async text file reader for botinfo/changelog/commandlist
utilities._cleanup_caches: Hourly job: remove stale entries from msg_locks, trigger_spam, spam_tracker, spam_warned, ignored_until

persistence.SQLitePersistence.__init__: Create table if not exists, initialize in-memory dicts
persistence.SQLitePersistence.load_all: Load all key-value pairs from SQLite, parse into bot_data/chat_data/user_data
persistence.SQLitePersistence.flush: Write all data back to SQLite (bot_data as single row, chat_data/user_data per-ID rows)
persistence.SQLitePersistence.clear_all: DELETE FROM persistence + clear all in-memory dicts
persistence.SetEncoder: Custom JSON encoder: set → {__type__: set, __items__: list}, deque → similar
persistence._object_hook: Reconstruct set and deque from JSON

features: ConsoleFormatter: colored output by log level (green INFO, yellow WARNING, red ERROR, red+yellow CRITICAL)
StatusCodeHandler: reclassify backend HTTP status codes (4xx → WARNING, 5xx → ERROR)
